response.sql:
WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        avg_spent,
        avg_remaining,
        avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS difference
    FROM event_averages
)
SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average remaining is calculated across all budget lines, ignoring NULL remaining values, as AVG does by default.
